tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because predict referenced an undefined train_rows variable. This corrected implementation fits parameters from train_rows inside fit, but predict needs those fitted parameters available; as written it still has no shared training state.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven observations already include independent variation in substrate and gradient; another expensive trajectory batch is not needed to fit the saturating interaction.
Auxiliary noise is irrelevant to identifying the smooth response law and is explicitly not worth its cost.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or plain Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observed substrate response is monotone concave over the sampled range, while the gradient-varied rows show a large, monotone inhibition effect not captured by the substrate-only Haldane form; a saturating substrate term with fitted gradient inhibition is better aligned with the observations.
